A BlitzLLVM extension: sets how bright SDR white is in nits while [AutoHDR](AutoHDR) shows the window in HDR. 203 is the usual value. By default (0) the program follows the SDR content brightness that the user set in the system, so it changes together with the slider. Takes effect with the next picture. The environment variable `BLITZLLVM_AUTOHDR_WHITE` sets it at start.
@param nits  The brightness of SDR white in nits, from 1 to 10000, or 0 to follow the system.
